ORGANIZATIONS/PSU/JOINT VENTURE COMPANY WHERE AT LEAST ONE OF TH E PARTNERS SHALL BE CENTRAL OR STATE GOVERNMENT ORGANIZATION OR PSU/PUBLIC LIMITED COMPANIES, DUR ING LAST SEVEN (07) YEARS ENDING LAST DAY OF MONTH PREVIOUS TO THE ONE IN WHICH TENDER IS ISSUED SHO ULD BE EITHER OF THE FOLLOWING: A) 03 COMPLETED WORK ORDERS EACH COSTING NOT LESS THAN RS.37 LAKHS. B) 02 COMPLETED WORK ORDERS EACH COSTING NOT LESS THAN RS.46 LAKHS. C) 01 COMPLETED WORK ORDERS EACH COSTING NOT LESS THAN RS.73 LAKHS. THE WORK ORDER AND COMPLETION CERTIFICATE / PAID BILLS SO SUBMITTED SHOULD BE IN THE NAME OF PARTICIPATING TENDERER. 2) THE TENDERER SHOULD HAVE MINIMUM AVERAGE ANNUAL FINANCIAL TURNOVER OF RS. 28 LAKHS DURING LAS T THREE CONSECUTIVE FINANCIAL YEAR ENDING 31.03.2026 CERTIFIED BY PRACTISING CHARTERED ACCOUNTANTS WITH VALID UDIN AND MEMBERSHIP NO WITH FOLLOWING.
